meaning:
χειρόγραφος, -ον
(χείρ, γράφω), [in LXX: Tob.5:3 9:2, 5 * ;]
written with the hand. As subst., τὸ χ., a handwriting (Inscr., Polyb., al.): metaphorically, Col.2:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
